summary: An unquoted ')' stops lex_atom without consuming input, causing repeated empty tokens and nontermination. Removing ')' from TOKEN_START lets the lexer consume it. The one-line verbatim reversal is established. However, the fix adds deb.toml regression fixtures exercised by custom decoder_compliance targets with harness = false, rather than a module-qualified Rust test function. No suitable named Rust test was established, so test is empty and this plan remains blocked. No tests were executed.
